lines: Steelers at Browns on Friday 8:15 am Perth opens Week 4 in the North. PIT -2.5, total 38.5, on Prime Video.
Three 3-0 teams are on show: Buffalo, Minnesota and the Raiders, who host Kansas City with KC -5.5 and a 47.5 total.
Baltimore beat Dallas 34-31 in Rio and now hosts winless Tennessee as an 11.5-point favourite.
Jacksonville, Cincinnati's Week 4 opponent, hammered New England 35-6 behind three Trevor Lawrence touchdown passes.
San Francisco is 3-0 after a 36-30 win over Arizona and hosts Denver as a 3-point favourite Monday 4:25 am Perth.
Houston, Miami, Tampa Bay and the Chargers are all 0-3 heading into Week 4.

postgame.what_decided_it: Two lost fumbles and no answer for the run. Pittsburgh ran 23 times for 138 yards at 6.0 a carry, won total yards 411 to 352, and Boswell's late kick settled it 30-27.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 28/37, 282 yds, 3 TD, 0 INT. Clean sheet through the air and still a loss.
Ja'Marr Chase: 9 rec, 98 yds, 1 TD. Tee Higgins added 6 rec, 90 yds, 1 TD.
Jaylen Warren: 17 car, 127 yds, plus 3 rec for 49. He set the tone for Pittsburgh.
postgame.division_meaning: Everyone is 2-1. Cincinnati sits third on tiebreak order despite the best point differential at +17, ahead of BAL +14, PIT -7, CLE -17. Only Cincinnati is on a losing streak.
postgame.the_take: Burrow gave you three touchdowns and zero picks and it still went sideways. Two fumbles lost and 138 rushing yards allowed is the whole story. Ben Baby's headline said it: miscues proved costly.
